verdict.rationale: Evidence implies a 1Password desktop app. The CLI integrates with 'your 1Password app' using Touch ID or Windows Hello, Git signing is configured 'from the 1Password app', and a user reports desktop and mobile apps 'work great'. OTP storage is documented but never tied to the desktop app, and community comments question how first-class it is (Electron rather than native, an older 'no Linux client' complaint). Missing for 10: first-party desktop app documentation, explicit evidence of one-time codes and vault browsing on desktop, and platform coverage details.

support.subject: As a power user, a first-class desktop app gives me codes and vault access on my computer, not just on mobile
